result.topic_en: A table for the star delta Ursae Minoris giving, at ten-day intervals from January 0 to April 20, a correction in arc-seconds, the differences between successive values, and a second small correction column.

methods.what: Tabulation of a periodic correction (likely aberration/nutation in position) for delta Ursae Minoris at 10-day intervals, with first differences written between the rows to check smoothness
